name: Eddy's Welding Inc
old_description: Eddy's Welding Inc. is a full-service welding and fabrication shop located in Ellicott City Maryland.
about:
Eddy's Welding Inc. operates a full-service welding and fabrication shop in Ellicott City, Maryland. The company was incorporated in 1991 and reports over 200 years of combined experience among its personnel. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The shop specializes in the fabrication and erection of miscellaneous and structural steel. Its capabilities cover welding, custom steel part fabrication, and on-site erection for a range of project types. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Eddy's Welding serves clients across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Project references include schools, churches, retail stores, office buildings, hospitals, parking garages, government agencies, military installations, and high-security or classified facilities.

The company highlights a safety-first approach, citing recent safety awards and fabrication and erection certifications as differentiators. Its location adjacent to Patapsco Valley State Park is noted as a source of inspiration for the team.
